content:
Amazon has refreshed its early-fall Prime Day deals with a fresh batch of discounts. We're still tracking the AirPods Pro 3 at $50 off, but today's lead comes from a $50 price drop on the all-new M5 Max Mac Studio. On top of launch deals on the new Beats 360 over-ear headphones, the Powerbeats Pro 2 are now also $50 off (or up to $116 off open-box at Best Buy), and a two-pack of Beats' 5-foot woven USB-C cables is just $14 with free Prime shipping. Those are alongside the latest wireless Ring Battery Doorbell 2K slashed 60% to $40, a slew of iPhone 18 Pro-exclusive case deals, chargers, and more details below.

Score AirPods Pro 3 with a $50 discount to complete your iPhone 18 Pro and Apple Watch experience

One of the best early-fall Prime Day deals right now drops Apple's latest flagship AirPods Pro 3 by $50, below their original price. Paired with the new iPhone 18 Pro, Apple Watch Series 12 and Ultra 4, the AirPods Pro 3 make up the ultimate experience.

Amazon is currently selling the Apple AirPods Pro 3 for $199 with shipping included.

Down from its original price of $249, this $50 discount undercuts Best Buy's deal for the best price available to anyone right now.

Apple recently launched the new AirPods 5, starting at $129, which now also include ANC. But if you're looking for 3x the ANC, a wireless charging case, longer battery life, and a built-in heart rate sensor for the flagship experience, the AirPods Pro 3 are the way to go. While the AirPods 5 with wireless charging case can be had for $149, they don't get the truly sealed ANC treatment and extra features of the Pro lineup.

Of course, there are some things to note — this is an ongoing deal that has been extended into the early-fall Prime Day deal event. That means Amazon will very likely drop the price further when its official Prime Big Deal Days kick off on October 6 (or earlier). We've seen Amazon drop the price to $189 or $179 before, and even as low as $169 during the summer Prime Day. The fall event in two weeks could repeat those prices, but we can't be 100% sure, and the $169 deal has come in and out of stock.

Apple's new 2026 M5 Max Mac Studio gets a $50 discount at Amazon

In addition to the return of the launch deal on the previously released M6 Mac mini, those looking to upgrade to Apple's previously released, more powerful 2026 Mac Studio can now get a brand new configuration at a new low price at Amazon.

Amazon is currently selling the all-new M5 Max Mac Studio with 36GB of RAM and 512GB of storage for $2,449 with shipping included.

Down from an original price of $2,499, this is a $50 discount. It's not the biggest discount, but if you want to upgrade early, saving $50 is better than nothing — and it's even $1 cheaper than the pre-order deal.

  • 2026 Mac Studio M5 Max 36GB/512GB $2,450 (originally $2,499)

Either way, early buyers can save some money, and for those who don't need the power of the M5 Max and 36GB of RAM, the earlier M6 Mac mini deals are back on select models:

  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/256GB $880 (originally $899)
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/512GB $1,070 (originally $1,099)
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 24GB/512GB $1,270 (originally $1,299)

Powerbeats Pro 2 are now $50 off at Amazon, or up to $116 off open-box at Best Buy

In addition to the ongoing AirPods Pro 3 discount and the launch deal on the new Beats 360 over-ear headphones, Amazon is also taking $50 off the latest Beats Powerbeats Pro 2. And Best Buy's "excellent condition" open-box deals can save you over $100.

Amazon is currently selling the latest Powerbeats Pro 2 in all four colors for $199.95 with shipping included.

Down from $250, this $50 discount matches what we've seen before. There have been very few times they've been able to sell for less, and this deal on new units is only $20 off Amazon's all-time low price.

Best Buy also has "excellent condition" open-box deals at even lower prices — all four colors are at or close to $100 off the new price:

  • Powerbeats Pro 2 Hyper Purple $134 (originally new $250)
  • Powerbeats Pro 2 Quick Sand $138 (originally new $250)
  • Powerbeats Pro 2 Jet Black $146 (originally new $250)
  • Powerbeats Pro 2 Electric Orange $152 (originally new $250)

However, if you're interested in the all-new Beats 360 over-ear headphones, you'll want to act fast, as the modular Beats 360 Cushion Kits are still available at 20% off during the launch period.

  • Beats 360 over-ear headphones $350
  • Beats 360 Cushion Kit $10 (originally $50)

iPhone 18 Pro case-exclusive deals: leather, metal, wood, faux suede and more

Latest wireless Ring Battery Doorbell 2K slashed to $40 (60% off, all-time low)

The early-fall Prime Big Deal Days deals have been updated with a new batch of discounts. In addition to the previously mentioned all-time low price of $100 off the latest Ring 4K smart doorbell, Amazon is also taking 60% off the latest wireless Ring Battery Doorbell 2K, dropping it to just $40.

Amazon is currently selling the latest Ring Battery Doorbell 2K for $39.99 with shipping included.

This model launched at $100 this spring and is now $60 off, which is a 60% discount and the lowest price we've ever seen. There was a decent deal of $50 during the summer Prime Day, and a few smaller drops of $70, but nothing as good as today.

Even though the official fall Prime Day big deals are more than a week away on October 6, this model, like the higher-end 4K version, is already seeing significant discounts. While there's theoretically still a chance it could drop further, the odds of a bigger price cut are slim to none.

If you want to upgrade to the 4K model, both the wireless and wired versions are also now at the lowest prices we've ever seen:

  • Ring Battery Doorbell 4K Pro $150 (originally $250)
  • Ring Wired Doorbell 4K Pro $150 (originally $250)

Today's accessory and charging deals:

  • Anker 140W 4-port MacBook charger with smart display drops to all-time low $56
  • Satechi 2026 ChargeView desktop charger with display 25% off for 9to5 readers (all-time low)
  • Anker SoloCam S220 solar security camera 2-pack + HomeBase 3 bundle $199 today only ($121 off), more
  • roborock's latest RockMow X115H or X130H robotic mowers hit new lows from $1,400, save up to $899
  • Govee underglow light kit adds soft or dynamic lighting to your ride for just $43
  • Anker's all-new 100W VALORANT limited edition charger brings agent themes to its smart display
  • UGREEN 300W 8-port smart desktop charger can replace a bunch of charger bricks, now down to a new low of $170

Burton Goods' newly launched leather iPhone 18 Pro/Max and Duo cases: 40% off for 9to5 readers

Add Hyper's latest Thunderbolt 5 dock to your new Mac setup, $80 off (Amazon low)
